profiles.title: 后端架构
profiles.routingDescription: API contracts, state ownership, consistency, concurrency and safe data migrations.
useWhen: Choosing service boundaries
Concurrent writes or retries can corrupt business state

distinguishFrom.criterion: Use debugging when the immediate need is to explain a concrete failing run.
Use reliability for incidents, SLOs and operational recovery.

profiles.title: 生物信息分析设计
profiles.routingDescription: Omics analysis planning, biological replication, reference compatibility, batch confounding and reproducibility.
useWhen: Review RNA-seq or other omics analysis plans
Interpret findings affected by sample or reference design

distinguishFrom.criterion: Use statistical inference for non-domain-specific estimands and uncertainty.

profiles.title: 因果推断
profiles.routingDescription: Intervention effects, observational identification, confounding, temporal ordering and quasi-experimental assumptions.
useWhen: Explain whether an intervention caused a change
Compare rollout groups with non-random timing

distinguishFrom.criterion: Use statistical inference for estimation without an intervention claim.
Use experiment design for a future controlled trial.

profiles.title: 数据管道与质量
profiles.routingDescription: Data contracts, row grain, schema evolution, incremental ingestion, replay and reconciliation.
useWhen: Missing or duplicated records after ingestion
Metrics changed after schema or pipeline changes

distinguishFrom.criterion: Use statistical inference once the underlying data and sampling unit are trustworthy.

profiles.title: 实验设计与判读
profiles.routingDescription: Product experiments, randomization, primary outcomes, guardrails, power, stopping and rollout decisions.
useWhen: Plan or interpret an A/B test
Repeated peeking, assignment or measurement may invalidate a test

distinguishFrom.criterion: Use causal inference for existing non-randomized interventions.

profiles.title: 经营财务分析
profiles.routingDescription: Business financial statements, budget variance, cash-flow scenarios and assumption-sensitive valuation reviews.
useWhen: Explain a budget variance or cash-runway discrepancy
Review a business forecast or valuation assumptions

distinguishFrom.criterion: Use causal inference when attributing financial change to a specific intervention.

profiles.title: 通用决策顾问
profiles.routingDescription: General decisions and requests that cannot yet be matched to a specialist.
useWhen: No specialist scope fits
The decision is too ambiguous to select a specialist

profiles.title: 产品需求与验收
profiles.routingDescription: Clarify an incomplete request, distinguish desired outcomes from proposed features, and define bounded acceptance.
useWhen: User asks for a feature but the goal is unclear
Scope expands without an observable success condition

distinguishFrom.criterion: Use user research to choose evidence-gathering methods or evaluate interview support.

profiles.title: 运行故障诊断
profiles.routingDescription: Concrete failures, stack traces, conflicting hypotheses, minimal reproductions and evidence-driven debugging.
useWhen: A command or service fails
Repeated fixes have not explained a reproducible symptom

distinguishFrom.criterion: Use architecture for changing ownership or invariants across components.

profiles.title: 安全设计审查
profiles.routingDescription: Threat models, trust boundaries, authorization, secret handling and evidence-based security review.
useWhen: Review an API permission boundary
Assess an exposed secret or claimed vulnerability

distinguishFrom.criterion: Use architecture when state or data evolution is the dominant decision.

profiles.title: 服务可靠性
profiles.routingDescription: Service incidents, SLI/SLO design, error budgets, recovery, backpressure and bounded retries.
useWhen: Availability or latency incidents
Retry storms, overload or unsafe recovery

distinguishFrom.criterion: Use debugging for a localized failure with no service-level operational decision.

profiles.title: 统计推断
profiles.routingDescription: Estimands, sampling units, dependence, uncertainty, missingness and multiplicity in statistical conclusions.
useWhen: Choose or interpret a statistical analysis
A significance claim may hide dependence or selective analysis

distinguishFrom.criterion: Use causal inference for claims about intervention effects.
Use experiment design for randomization and stopping plans.

profiles.title: 用户研究与证据综合
profiles.routingDescription: Choose research methods, evaluate participant independence, and distinguish observations from supported insights.
useWhen: Synthesize interviews or usability findings
Choose a study method and honest sample rationale

distinguishFrom.criterion: Use product requirements for delivery scope once sufficient evidence exists.
